Image reference: assets/2026-10-01_arabian-gulf-crude-freight-outlook_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_90560891a7d7.png
East West Pipeline Red Sea Risk and the Wider Tanker Market
Saudi exports are recovering through both Hormuz and Yanbu, but the additional barrels are moving through a vessel intensive system that has not restored normal tanker availability or voyage costs. This week's Allied QuantumSea Research reviews the latest phase of Saudi crude export recovery. The East-West Pipeline is moving about 3.5 million barrels per day and overseas shipments from Yanbu have resumed.
